Prevention: The rice nursery should not be sown before the 20th of
Destruction of rice stubbles after crop harvest.
Removal of infested plants at the time of up-rooting the nursery.
Apply nitrogen fertilizer in split following the recommended rate and time of application.
Monitoring: Weekly pest scouting of crops (20 days after sowing of nursery).
Monitoring of egg masses present underside the leaf surface.
Direct Control: Release egg/larval and pupal parasitoids for natural control.
Before transplanting, cut the leaf-top to reduce carry-over of eggs from the seedbed to the field.
Restrictions: Do not drink, eat or smoke whilst spraying chemicals.
Wear protective clothing, i.e. gloves, boots, masks and goggles while handling and spraying pesticides.
Use of cartap hydrochloride 4G (nereistoxin analogue insecticide) @ 9kg/Ac.
Cartap should be used in standing water.
Use of fipronil (Refree 0.3% G) phenylpyrazole insecticide @ 8 kg/acre.
Use benfuracarb (Oncol 3% G) @ 8 kg per acre.
